title: LogQuant: Log-Distributed 2-Bit Quantization of KV Cache with Superior Accuracy Preservation

contributions.purpose: 找到一种更可靠的估计 KV cache 中 token 重要性的依据(既非'后来的 token 更重要', 也非基于早期注意力预测)
contributions.mechanism: 分析多个模型和下游任务的注意力头, 观察到高注意力尖峰(spike)的位置随离当前位置变远而呈对数分布(越稀疏)
contributions.evaluation: 定性观察, 见 Figure 1/3 的注意力分布可视化; 是后续方法的动机, 无独立数字
contributions.domain: LLM 推理 / KV cache 压缩
contributions.source_quote: We observe that in various models and downstream tasks, the positions of high attention spikes follow a log distribution, becoming sparser as tokens move further from the current position. This insight underpins our approach to estimate token importance.

contributions.purpose: 在 2-bit 高压缩率下比现有 KV cache 压缩方法更好地保留精度
contributions.mechanism: LogQuant: 基于对数分布观察, 用一组对数分布窗口(2W 保留最近连续 token 全精度, 之后 W/2 隔一取一, W/4 再隔, 末端保留 3W)在整段上下文上选择性保留关键 token 全精度, 与 2-bit 量化结合(对数驱逐 + 量化)
contributions.evaluation: GSM8K + LongBench(21 数据集/6 类任务), 跨 Llama3.1-8B、Qwen1.5/2、Phi3 等多模型; Math/Code Completion 等复杂任务同压缩率下比 KiVi/H2O 精度提升 40%-200%; 4-bit 下与基线几乎无差, 2-bit 下有明显下降但优于 KiVi
contributions.domain: LLM 推理 / KV cache 量化
contributions.source_quote: Leveraging this log-distribution observation, we introduce LogQuant, a 2-bit quantization technique that significantly improves accuracy. LogQuant outperforms existing methods like KiVi and H2O by better preserving important tokens, achieving a 40% to 200% improvement in accuracy on complex tasks such as Math and Code Completion with the same or higher compression ratio.

contributions.purpose: 在不影响注意力结果的前提下加速量化/反量化, 提升吞吐
contributions.mechanism: 利用解码阶段注意力对 KV token 顺序不变的性质, 忽略 KV cache 条目的绝对位置(position-agnostic), 将高精度 token 与量化 token 拼接以增强内存局部性
contributions.evaluation: H100 48G MIG + HuggingFace pipeline, 平均 prompt 512/最大输出 2000, Llama3.1-8B: 吞吐提升约 25%, 相同内存下 batch size 提升 60%
contributions.domain: LLM 推理 / 系统效率
contributions.source_quote: By ignoring the absolute positions of KV cache entries, our method further optimizes the speed of quantization/dequantization process without affecting the final attention results, resulting in a 25% increase in throughput and a 60% increase in batch size.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Inspired by the observation of sink tokens (Xiao et al., 2023), which are the first few tokens that consistently receive high attention scores, we included these tokens in the set maintained at original precision to improve accuracy in 2-bit quantization.

KiVi (Liu et al., 2024c) introduces a 2-bit quantization by retaining a recent window of full-precision tokens... Inspired by attention patterns as Figure 1, we propose combining a logarithmic eviction strategies with quantization.

notes: 方法定位为对 KiVi(2-bit + 最近窗口全精度)和 sink-token(Xiao 2023)思路的改进/组合。负结果/trade-off 信号: (1)消融显示只把 sink token 保持高精度收益极小(Table 1, 'minimal improvement'), 说明单靠 sink token 不够; (2)2-bit 量化本身相对基线有明显精度下降(内存 vs 精度 trade-off), 简单任务几乎无影响但 Math/Code/Synthetic 受损明显; (3)公平性 caveat: 保留长度 R=128 时 LogQuant 实际只有 126 个全精度 token, 略少于 KiVi 的 128; (4)吞吐提升受 HuggingFace pipeline 限制(量化 cache 未及时释放原始 KV 状态、反量化拖慢吞吐), 作者留作 future work。paper under review(reject)。
